Operational finding (relates to #50 CNI-residue class but distinct). After a Mac sleep/wake the Lima VM (vz) stayed Running with its LAN IP on lima0 (192.168.254.202) and k3s-agent active, but the socket_vmnet bridge was L2-dead: k3s-agent logged 'dial tcp 192.168.254.194:6443: connect: no route to host' and the control-plane host could not ARP .202 (node NotReady/unreachable). Neither a Cilium restart nor waiting recovered it; `limactl stop openinfra-arm64 && limactl start openinfra-arm64` (which tears down and re-creates the bridged socket_vmnet daemon) restored L2 and the node went Ready in one poll. Sanctioned recovery for the standing arm64 node after a Mac sleep.
